rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Ethereum
positions.catalyst: Rotate BTC->ETH on the one liquid major with a fresh, structural bid. Spot ETH ETFs broke an 8-week outflow streak and logged a 2nd-3rd consecutive week of net creations (~$105M week of 7/13-17; positive daily prints 7/20-21), with BlackRock's ETHA leading and its new ETHB staking ETF (80% staked ETH, yield passed through) adding a demand source plain spot funds lack. Ethereum's validator exit queue is near-empty amid a staking surge, tightening float. ETH has shown relative strength, recovering from late-June multi-year lows near $1,566 to ~$1,857-1,915 while BTC sees ETF OUTFLOWS (-$225M Thu). On a risk-off tape (Fear&Greed 27, higher yields/tariffs/oil), ETH pairs a fresh idiosyncratic catalyst with major-coin liquidity and a definable stop.
positions.driver: Closed BTC at 64,033.86 for a small -$72.20 loss (defensive base-hold gave back a hair; BTC carried NO fresh catalyst and bled ETF outflows). Rotated to ETH as the asymmetric setup: freshest coin-specific catalyst (ETF inflow-streak reversal + BlackRock staking ETF + empty exit queue) plus relative strength vs BTC/SOL, while still being a liquid major with contained downside. Wins vs runners-up: BTC (~64,034) is purely defensive with outflows and no catalyst; SOL (~73.97, -2.2% today) has the Morgan Stanley 0.14% spot ETF story but is the weakest of the three today and higher-beta into the 7/28-29 FOMC. ETH gives the best risk-adjusted 24h payoff with an 8% major stop.
positions.risks: Risk-off macro is the main threat: higher Treasury yields, tariff/oil-driven inflation fears, and a hawkish 7/28-29 FOMC could drag the whole complex; Fear&Greed at 27 signals fragile sentiment. ETH-specific: ETF inflows are early and could stall, and ETH remains beta to BTC. A break below the ~$1,800 area invalidates the recovery. Hard stop 1708.84 (-8%, majors rule) caps downside while giving room above near-term support.
